clause: Output ground has positive eigenvalue a² for AA*
evidence_or_owed: Displayed with its domain statement, derived from condition (v) and the bridge. The text adds that the weak bridge alone does not give it, on the unequal-cell path.

clause: Ground with any nonzero image in the product-domain statement
evidence_or_owed: The quadratic form of the input return is the squared norm of the image, so the kernels of the two returns are the kernels of A and of its adjoint. No bridge is used.

clause: Constraints on taking structural returns as proposed ground generators
draft_quote: It constrains any attempt to take the returns as the sector Hamiltonians.
evidence_or_owed: The unshifted input return cannot have the ground at energy zero under the bridge. The shifted return has the ground at its bottom only under strong compatibility and without a kernel. Under R5 and strong compatibility the output ground is not a ground of the output return. On the unequal-cell path and in the pair preparation the returns select other states.

clause: Forward image, vanishing square, and annihilation of every output vector
evidence_or_owed: Displayed for the differential on its whole domain, with the same statement for its negative and the remark that the model generates no iterated sequence.

clause: Meaning of annihilation by the typed forward operator
draft_quote: It does not describe an evolution that removes $y$. It records that the map is not applied to output vectors.
evidence_or_owed: The zero on the output summand is attributed to the typing of the map and separated from any evolution of the ground, which the next sentences show can keep or move it.

clause: No second act is needed to make the occurrence manifest
draft_quote: On that reading no second act is needed to make it manifest.
evidence_or_owed: The consequence of the opening's reading, that a cognition is manifest in its occurrence, is stated next to the vanishing of the differential on the output summand. Whether that vanishing expresses reflexivity is left as a further identification.

clause: Preservation of the ground line and projective survival
evidence_or_owed: The block condition, the vector condition and the vanishing of the variance are equated. Keeping the ground ray requires a nonzero mean, and an annihilating operator keeps the line without keeping the ray.

draft_quote: Both $X$ and $X^*$ map the line into itself exactly when $X$ commutes with $P_y$
evidence_or_owed: One-sided preservation is shown not to imply the two-sided condition, by an explicit operator. The two-sided condition is commutation with the ground projection and makes the line reducing. For a unitary one side gives the other, and for a self-adjoint operator the condition is an eigenvector.

clause: Unitary preservation, scalar character and generator eigenvector for all real times
evidence_or_owed: The three conditions are displayed and proved through the character of the group and the spectral theorem, including the domain of the generator. An example shows that preservation at isolated times is not enough.

clause: Typed terminality places no restriction on independent ground dynamics
draft_quote: It places no condition on how a channel treats the grounds.
evidence_or_owed: The vanishing of the differential on the output summand holds for every map. In the shift example one preparation is shared by a channel that carries the input ground to the output ground and by channels that send it to the missing line.

clause: Rank-one requirement on each moment's ground projection
draft_quote: Each ground projection $P_{y_n}$ has rank one.
evidence_or_owed: Stated for each moment, with uniqueness of each moment's ground ray as R2 imposed at that moment.
